diseases.name: Rust (Yellow/Brown)
diseases.symptoms: Yellow or brown pustules on leaves
diseases.remedy: Grow resistant varieties like HD 2967, spray Propiconazole

diseases.name: Pink Bollworm
diseases.symptoms: Larvae bore into bolls, staining lint
diseases.remedy: Use pheromone traps, spray Emamectin Benzoate

diseases.name: Leaf Curl Virus
diseases.remedy: Control whitefly vectors using Neem oil

general_advice.fertilizers: Use NPK in appropriate ratios based on soil tests. Organic manure is recommended for long-term health.
general_advice.irrigation: Drip irrigation is efficient for water-scarce regions. Flood irrigation is common for rice.
general_advice.pesticides: Always wear protective gear while spraying. Follow safety periods before harvesting.
